name: After § 18
title: REPORT on the protection of minors online
part_text: 18a. Stresses that the protection of minors requires targeted and effective measures, while emphasising that the fight against child sexual abuse cannot justify disproportionate intrusions into privacy and the confidentiality of correspondence; points out in this regard that the ‘Chat Control’ proposal exemplifies such disproportionate measures, as it would mandate the preventive scanning of all EU citizens’ private communications, constituting a disproportionate intrusion into privacy in disregard of Article 7 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union, which guarantees respect for private and family life, home and communications;
